decisions.reason: As a low-cost add-on tightly linked to the core web-mapping stack, it is still worth keeping open, although the lack of later visibility raises some risk of future consolidation.
After several years with no visible follow-up, this narrowly scoped mobile control component likely no longer offers enough unresolved upside to justify keeping it as a separate product.
The GIS platform is a flagship product line aligned with the firm's strategic direction, so management would continue to support it unless there were much clearer signs of failure.
Mobile field data capture is closer to a full solution and therefore costlier to maintain, and with no later market signal its option value appears too limited to merit further standalone commitment.
Given overlap with other search-related offerings and the firm's earlier withdrawal of a related search product, this extension is the most likely candidate for rationalization.
